messages:
alex: Quick checklist for marketplace go-live tomorrow — need quick thumbs. Main asks: SI sandbox creds handed to partners? hardware partners have staging slots reserved? press/blog embargo aligned to 09:00 PT? landing page CTA final? UTM/campaign tags in the tracking doc? anyone running last-minute content reviews?

dana: @alex 09:00 PT embargo is fine. blog is queued for 09:05 PT publish. i'll hold the publish until hero copy is locked. sent draft to #marketing-docs earlier — legal still checking trademark line. :white_check_mark:

mira: Staging certs and test VPC routes are green, but SI partners need rotated sandbox keys (we saw connector timeouts when uploads exceed 60s). @jon can you confirm SI can consume the sandbox with the new client_id? i'll keep an eye on Dedicated preview routing.

jon: I can rotate keys and push them via secure share. Plan: generate new client_id/client_secret pair with TTL=48h and a one-time note to partners. Rotation command i'll run now: 

```
# rotate sandbox creds
redwoodctl creds rotate --env sandbox --partner acme-si,edgeworks --ttl 48h
```

I'll also publish the SI runbook changes (connector retry backoff and idempotency notes). scheduling cutover smoke tests at 13:00 PT — partners asked to run connector smoke and report results in #support.

alex: deploy-bot — what's the release window and rollback policy? any automated fallback if listing API errors spike?

deploy-bot: Release window reserved 09:00-09:30 PT. Auto-rollback rule: "drop-to-hosted-fallback" if 5xx rate > 2% sustained for 10m. Post-rollout alert to eng-oncall and partner-ops.

dana: Landing page QA: hero CTA changed to "Try Redwood Inference" — legal requested trademark verification, so please don't edit copy in the doc until legal confirms. tracking: added UTM params to the tracking sheet (utm_source=partner-marketplace, utm_campaign=marketplace_launch_may).

mira: Freezing copy now in the doc. Also flagged a model-version mismatch in Dedicated preview — routing to v1.2.3 to avoid hallucination regression. I'll push a small config pin before 08:45 PT.

jon: SI checklist completed: shared 1Password item for partners (acme-si, edgeworks), asked them to run smoke tests and post a screenshot. also added runbook steps for connector rollback and requeueing failed uploads.

alex: Thanks all — if we have thumbs by 08:30 PT i'll greenlight embargo lift. if you're blocked, reply with a short note and i'll escalate. :raised_hands:

dana: thumbs up :thumbsup:

mira: thumbs up

jon: thumbs up
__notes: thread is a single continuous message string with messages prefixed by sender name as required
